commands.name: style
commands.description: Reply style for this session: /style normal · /style plain (high school tone) · /style visual (ASCII diagrams)

commands.name: pending
commands.description: What is pending here: baton, parked items with ages, open handoffs for this session. Reads the files, no model call.

commands.name: park
commands.description: Park a thread before you pivot: /park "what" "next step"

commands.name: unpark
commands.description: Remove parked item n (as numbered by /pending): /unpark 2

commands.name: handover
commands.description: Write Claude_Memory/HANDOVER_<successor>.md from this session and copy the kickoff prompt: /handover Code-4

commands.name: close
commands.description: Before closing this session: git clean, INDEX and HANDOFFS updated today, nothing of yours parked too long.
commands.output:
✔ git: working tree clean
✔ INDEX.md: not in this project (skipped)
✔ HANDOFFS.md: not in this project (skipped)
✔ ⏳ Parked: nothing of this session older than 7 days
✘ Only in this conversation: OK

Not yet: 1 item above.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Your open Claude Code sessions, this project first, then the others by project.

commands.name: relay
commands.description: Send text, or the last START/END block of my last reply, to another session: /relay Code-4 last · /relay Jackfruit/Code-QC <text>

commands.name: build
commands.description: This turn may change files and production after all (askmode marked it a question).
commands.output: Nothing was held: this turn was not marked a question.

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote the newest staged version of this agent and its paired agents, from a pane with one Promote button per agent. Refuses on a dirty git tree.
commands.output: No lua.skill.yaml or Claude_Memory above this folder.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: What watch saw in the agent logs since you last asked: errors, preprocessor blocks, gate bypasses, failing checks.
commands.output: watch has not looked yet (it runs every 10 min in a folder with lua.skill.yaml, or set "agent" in .claude-mods.json).

commands.name: testmode
commands.description: Protect real recipients while you test: /testmode on | off | status. Bash naming a protected address, or lua env setting a recipient key, is refused while on.
commands.output: Test mode is off. Protected: (none in .claude-mods.json).

commands.name: secret
commands.description: Hold a secret for this session from the clipboard, never in the transcript: /secret set NAME, then use $NAME in commands. /secret list · /secret clear
commands.output: Usage: /secret set NAME (the value is read from the clipboard) · /secret list · /secret clear

commands.name: outbox
commands.description: Drafts for your contacts kept in Claude_Memory/MESSAGES.md, in a pane with Copy, Copy for Slack and Mark sent.
commands.output: No Claude_Memory above this folder, so no MESSAGES.md.
